mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_friend_request (from_user_id, to_user_id, status) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_friend_request WHERE (from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId}) OR (from_user_id = #{toUserId} AND to_user_id = #{fromUserId}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_friend_request WHERE to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM t_friend_request WHERE from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_friend_request SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
